testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-signed-in.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23124 sales rep vouchers list shows only assigned users' vouchers

scenario.summary: A sales rep signs in to admin and opens OMS > Vouchers: the voucher of its assigned user is listed and the voucher of a user not assigned to it is not.
steps: Sign in to the admin panel as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password).
Search the list for the assigned user's voucher (@voucherAssigned.code, @voucherAssigned.name) and the other user's voucher (@voucherOther.code, @voucherOther.name).
assertions: The assigned user's voucher is listed
The other user's voucher is not listed (No records found. when searched)
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Vouchers' under the Sales Rep sections: vouchers of assigned users only.
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (analysis answer 2).
The test case cites bug Z10-28498 (Done): a failure is a regression (analysis answer 5).
Vouchers: VOUCHER_ISSUED_TO_USER collection outputs voucherId, name, code, amount; the test searches by code and checks the name.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
